name: Zero Mile International Airport
tagline: Ahmedabad, Mumbai and Bengaluru, merged under one roof near Nagpur's Zero Mile. Six runways, one continuous roof, and a Hall whose three gateway lobes each point home.

apm.note: double-track pinched loop under the Mall

landside.label: Metro spur to the Orange Line

merged.name: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International
merged.carries: edges and screens: jaali, shade, water; the stepwell forecourt; the unity marker

merged.name: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International
merged.carries: structure: branching columns, coffers with coloured lenses, the 40 m cantilever, the art spine

merged.name: Kempegowda International
merged.carries: the underside: bamboo soffits, hanging gardens, the garden valley and courts, MARS stands

lobes.role: domestic security and the transfer centre

dna.note: Each gateway lobe points within 8 degrees of its city. The two western lobes frame the June and December sunset azimuths (295 and 245 degrees); the west valley between them faces the equinox sunset.

phase2.note: Phase 2 (to 260 million passengers): two linear satellites, G and H, replace the east remote rows; remote stands move to the pier-tip aprons.
